description: Introspect what mortgage/loan data the API covers BEFORE scanning — which states, lenders, and product types are present, row counts per segment, and last-updated freshness per segment. Returns a coverage matrix so an agent can pick a scannable state/product before calling scan_savings or get_financing_decision. For RV scope it also separates the full RV catalog, rows carrying numeric score bounds, and the strict proof-backed rows actually eligible for credit_score matching; never describe score-match counts as the full RV inventory. Boats, RVs, motorcycles, and powersports are first-class product categories; auto means cars.

freshness_days.description: Optional uniform staleness window in days (1-90). OMIT to use per-category freshness windows — supplying a value overrides every category and is echoed back as freshness_mode=override.

product_category.description: Optional. Restrict the matrix to one product category. Omit for all.

state.description: Optional 2-letter US state code to scope the matrix to a single state.

name: get_coverage

coverage.description: Which states and product types appear in the data, as flat lists.

product_types.description: Product type keys present, possibly truncated — see product_types_truncated_from.

product_types_truncated_from.description: Full number of product types before the list above was truncated for display. Null when nothing was truncated.

states.description: Two-letter state codes present in this coverage snapshot.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

freshness_days.description: Age limit in days a rate must be within to be counted here; rows older than this are excluded from the totals.

freshness_mode.description: How the freshness window was chosen: 'per_category' applies a category-specific window instead of one global value.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this coverage snapshot was computed.

institution_profiles.description: Coverage of the NCUA institution reference data that backs lender context, separate from rate coverage.

branches.description: Total branch records held across all profiles.

cycle_date.description: Quarter-end date of the NCUA call report the profiles come from.

linked_credit_unions.description: Number of credit unions successfully linked to an NCUA profile.

member_counts.description: Number of profiles carrying a member count.

source.description: Name of the regulatory dataset behind the institution profiles.

websites.description: Number of profiles carrying a website URL; the shortfall against `profiles` is the gap.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools given this coverage picture, as bare tool names.

note.description: Plain-English description of how this coverage matrix is grouped and what it totals.

rv_credit_score_coverage.description: Present for all-product or RV coverage requests. Separates the full RV inventory from the smaller proof-backed numeric score-matching surface.

definition.description: Plain-English definition of the fail-closed score-matchable count.

general_rates_included_in_score_matches.description: Always false: general RV rates are not assumed to apply to a requested score.

lenders_with_numeric_bounds.description: Distinct RV lenders with at least one row carrying a numeric score boundary.

lenders_with_unbucketed_rows.description: Distinct RV lenders contributing at least one general unbucketed row; lenders may also contribute bucketed rows.

matchable_lenders.description: Distinct lenders contributing at least one strict score-matchable RV row.

matchable_rows.description: RV rows eligible for public credit_score matching after freshness, rankability, source, evidence, RV identity, boundary, and rate checks.

product_category.description: Always 'rv' for this specialized coverage block.

rows_with_numeric_bounds.description: RV rows carrying at least one normalized numeric credit-score boundary before the strict public proof policy is applied.

state.description: Two-letter state scope, or null for nationwide coverage.

total_lenders.description: Distinct credit unions contributing any fresh visible RV row.

total_rows.description: All fresh visible RV rows in scope, including general pricing with no numeric score bucket.

unbucketed_rows.description: General RV rows with neither numeric score boundary. These remain in the RV catalog but are never returned as score matches.

segments.description: Coverage broken down by the requested grouping, largest first.

apr.description: Observed APR range in this segment, as min and max in percent. Wide ranges usually mean the segment mixes dissimilar products.

credit_unions.description: Number of distinct credit unions contributing to this segment.

is_fresh.description: True when the segment's newest rate falls inside window_days; false means the segment is stale and should be quoted with caution.

key.description: Machine key for the segment, e.g. 'CA|30-year-fixed'.

last_updated.description: UTC timestamp of the newest rate in this segment.

product_category.description: Broad category the segment belongs to, e.g. 'mortgage'.

product_type.description: Product type of the segment. 'other' is a catch-all for products that did not classify into a named type.

rows.description: Number of rate rows in this segment.

state.description: Two-letter state code of the segment. Null when the grouping is not state-based.

window_days.description: Freshness window in days applied to this specific segment.

totals.description: Overall size of the covered dataset within the freshness window.

credit_unions.description: Number of distinct credit unions contributing those rows.

product_types.description: Number of distinct product types represented.

rows.description: Number of individual rate rows counted.
